query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS total_requests = COUNT(*),
        distinct_source_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip),
        distinct_paths = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.path),
        off_host_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE source.ip != "127.0.0.1",
        loopback_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE source.ip == "127.0.0.1",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
| EVAL duration_hours = DATE_DIFF("hour", first_seen, last_seen)
